# Introduction

The **`kappaSizeCI`** analysis (Confidence Interval Approach for the Number of Subjects Required) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Number of subjects an interobserver agreement study needs for the confidence interval around the anticipated kappa (kappa0) to reach the requested precision - the confidence-interval approach of the kappaSize package. This is NOT a power calculation and tests no hypothesis; use kappaSizePower to size a study for a hypothesis test, and kappaSizeFixedN when the number of subjects is already fixed.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("kappaSizeCI_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::kappaSizeCI(
#   data = kappaSizeCI_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `kappaSizeCI` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
